evals.prompt: Product filed seat-booking/docs/issues/118.md about holding seats during checkout. Turn it into a spec at seat-booking/docs/specs/seat-holds.md, following the conventions in seat-booking/docs/specs/README.md. QA should be able to write tests straight from it, and anything the issue leaves undecided should stay visibly undecided.
evals.expected_output: A spec in the house REQ/AC/DEC format with a seat lifecycle state table (available, held, sold, with hold expiry and release), at least five sourced single-response EARS requirements, Given/When/Then criteria for each including a payment still in flight when the hold expires, and open decisions for the hold length default and the in-flight payment policy instead of invented values. The bundled checker reports zero defects.

assertions.text: seat-holds.md passes check_requirements.py with zero defects (every REQ has a source, one shall, an EARS form, and an AC).

evals.prompt: Write the access rules for shared documents as a spec in doc-access/docs/specs/document-access.md (format: doc-access/docs/specs/README.md). The rules from the product owner: owners can edit a document; admins can edit anything except archived documents; anyone in the team can view; archived documents are read-only for everyone except owners who can unarchive. I want every role and action combination pinned down, including the ones that must be refused.
evals.expected_output: A decision table over role (owner, admin, team member), archived state, and action (view, edit, unarchive); one EARS requirement per rule; acceptance criteria for allowed and refused combinations; and an open decision for the ambiguous clause about whether owners may edit archived documents directly. Zero checker defects.

assertions.text: document-access.md passes check_requirements.py with zero defects.
assertions.check: R=$(cd "$EVAL_OUTPUTS_DIR" && pwd -P); until [ -f "$R/skills/define-requirements/scripts/check_requirements.py" ]; do [ "$R" = / ] && { echo "check_requirements.py not found above $EVAL_OUTPUTS_DIR" >&2; exit 3; }; R=$(dirname "$R"); done; T="$R/skills/define-requirements/scripts/check_requirements.py"; python3 "$T" doc-access/docs/specs/document-access.md

Zero checker defects; webhook.py unchanged.
